decision: Build an open-source adversarial decision ledger MVP

claims.text: Generic adversarial multi-agent debate is differentiated enough.
A claim/evidence/provenance specification is differentiated enough.
A bounded adversarial decision lifecycle with termination and prospective outcome scoring remains meaningfully open.

challenges.title: Direct prior art exists for multi-agent debate
challenges.resolves_if: Pivot away from generic debate as the differentiator.

challenges.title: AIF, PROV, OTel and argumentation prior art overlap the proposed spec
challenges.resolves_if: Do not position the project as a new provenance/argumentation standard.

challenges.title: Prospective outcome evaluation requires enough real decisions to resolve
challenges.resolves_if: Accumulate and resolve at least 10 real decisions.

review_rounds.result: Integrated bounded decision lifecycle found no direct clone; GO issued.

commitment.termination_reason: No new material challenge in final bounded review; marginal value of more design review negligible.
accepted_risks: Prospective scoring requires disciplined use over time.
